notes.name: microphone_preamp.md
notes.text:
Microphone preamplifier GUI task:
- Created microphone_preamp project directly in /home/cua/kicad_project/. Final step 100 shows clean title and saved schematic status at /home/cua/kicad_project/microphone_preamp.kicad_sch.
- Installed switched mono jack is Connector_Audio:AudioJack2_Switch; Connector:AudioJack2_SwitchT_SwitchS search had no matches. Jack terminals top to bottom S, SN, T, TN. Short SN to TN on an isolated net, ground S, connect T to bias resistor and input capacitor negative.
- Device:C_Polarized default positive is upward. Three r presses makes positive right, one makes positive left. Device:R_Potentiometer three r presses gives pin 1 right, pin 3 left, wiper downward. Device:D_Schottky three r presses gives cathode upward.
- Ctrl+D retained values and allocated sequential references. Built 7 resistors, 3 polarized capacitors, RV1, U1 LM741, J1, two Schottky diodes, and +12V/+3V3/GND symbols. No signal labels.
- ERC step 94 reported exactly 3 undriven input-power errors for the externally supplied +12V, +3V3 and GND symbols, zero warnings. No unspecified power flags added. Wiring correctness is based on visual review and ERC, not an independent netlist comparison.
- Export: File (10,58), hover Export (83,192), Netlist (198,219), KiCad tab default, Export Netlist (650,774), verified microphone_preamp.net and kicad_project directory, Save (757,913). Ctrl+S afterward cleared export-induced title star.
- F1 zoom shifted view; Home then toolbar zoom-in (221,86) gave usable centered view. Toolbar zoom-out (238,86) used once for final full-circuit view.
- Prior results: infrared 0.33, dual rail 0.00, empty-netlist 1.00, power-tree 0.00, adjustable LDO 1.00, instrumentation value edit 1.00. These validate simple value-edit/save workflows and empty export only; this populated circuit has no evaluator result yet.
